statement: For every full section of U_ell, the residual Legendre representation becomes unramified after a quadratic twist at every q outside {2,ell} union the prime divisors of ell²−1. Local point-or-cusp input only at that finite set suffices for the residual reducibility theorem.
depends_on: A.3; A.5–A.6; A.28; Hoshi2012 Appendix A Proposition A.6
answers: A.11 local conditions in R3; Lead4 conductor consequences
notes: The quadratic character itself can ramify. The separate all-place descent input for R4 remains. This is an explicit sufficient local set for the proof, not a claim of absolute logical minimality.

statement: The natural global quotient retaining the entire prime-to-three geometric group of U7 and its residual Legendre7 representation admits a section with the prime-to-three data of a global cusp and wild residual inertia of order3 at3, unremovable by a quadratic twist.
depends_on: Exact SL2(F7) calculation; profinite Goursat lemma; cyclic cubic character of Q(zeta9)^+; Stix2014 Lemma16
answers: A.11 mixed-prime residual obstruction; Lead4 scope
notes: rho=diag(chi7 theta,theta^-1), with theta of conductor9. The geometric joint image is P^(3') times SL2(F7). This is an actual section of the natural joint quotient, without any claim of lifting to the full fundamental group.

statement: Intrinsic ramification and ramification of a cocycle in a chosen splitting agree at good reduction but cannot be interchanged at bad primes; for q|n odd Fermat boundary inertia already acts nontrivially in geometric abelianization for every section.
depends_on: Hoshi2012 Appendix A Definition A.1, Propositions A.2, A.4, A.6, A.7; ramification of qth roots of unity; boundary Tate module
answers: A.9 bad-prime terminology; A.11 local hypothesis scope
notes: No claim that a local interior point is automatically separated from all cusp packets in a pro-lambda quotient. The good-reduction ramification criterion does not establish that assertion at q|n.

statement: The proper elliptic curve X0(27) has a Z5-family of full global sections whose nonzero members are point-induced at every completion except Q5 and are nongeometric at Q5.
depends_on: A.10; A.14; Milne2006 I Theorems4.10(c),5.1, Corollaries3.4,4.15; compact cohomology and Kummer exact sequences
answers: A.11 failure of density-one local geometry to imply all-place descent
notes: Global Euler characteristic gives rank H1(G_Q,{3,5,infinity},T5E) at least1, whereas finite E(Q) and finiteSha make the all-place compact5-Selmer group zero. At q≠5 the entire full local section is realized by one 5-primary torsion point. This is a full genus-one example, without a hyperbolic lift claim.
